name: update_support_ticket
description: Change the status or priority of an existing ticket, or append a note to it. At least one of status, note or priority must be supplied. Closed tickets are immutable: open a new ticket instead of reopening one.

note.description: Text appended to the ticket's note history.

error_returns.when: No ticket exists with the given ticket_id.
None of status, note or priority was supplied, or status/priority is not one of the listed values.
